      (SELECT count(*) FROM tracks WHERE genre_id = g.id) AS trackCount,
      coalesce((SELECT revision FROM genre_order_revisions WHERE genre_id = g.id), 0) AS revision
    FROM genres g WHERE g.id = ?

SELECT o.id AS id, t.path IS NOT NULL AS hasFile,
      substr(o.title_sort, 1, 1) AS letter,
      o.title_sort AS k0, o.artist_sort AS k1, o.path AS k2, o.id AS k3
      , t.title AS title, t.artist_credit AS artist, t.duration_ms AS durationMs,
            w.thumb_path AS thumbPath, t.path AS path, t.explicit AS explicit,
            t.album_id AS albumId, t.artist_id AS artistId, t.has_lyrics AS hasLyrics,
            (SELECT name FROM genres WHERE genres.id = t.genre_id) AS genre,
            t.track_number AS trackNumber, t.year AS year
    FROM genre_order o INDEXED BY genre_order_title_asc
    CROSS JOIN tracks t ON t.id = o.id
    LEFT JOIN artwork w ON w.hash = t.artwork_hash
    WHERE o.genre_id = ?
    ORDER BY o.title_sort ASC, o.artist_sort ASC, o.path ASC, o.id ASC
    LIMIT ?
SELECT revision FROM genre_order_revisions WHERE genre_id = ?

SELECT o.id AS id, t.path IS NOT NULL AS hasFile,

SELECT g.id AS id, g.name AS name, g.sort AS sort,
      (SELECT count(*) FROM tracks WHERE genre_id = g.id) AS trackCount,
      coalesce((SELECT revision FROM genre_order_revisions WHERE genre_id = g.id), 0) AS revision
    FROM genres g WHERE g.id = ?

SELECT o.id AS id, t.path IS NOT NULL AS hasFile,
      substr(o.title_sort, 1, 1) AS letter,
      o.title_sort AS k0, o.artist_sort AS k1, o.path AS k2, o.id AS k3
      , t.title AS title, t.artist_credit AS artist, t.duration_ms AS durationMs,
            w.thumb_path AS thumbPath, t.path AS path, t.explicit AS explicit,
            t.album_id AS albumId, t.artist_id AS artistId, t.has_lyrics AS hasLyrics,
            (SELECT name FROM genres WHERE genres.id = t.genre_id) AS genre,
            t.track_number AS trackNumber, t.year AS year
    FROM genre_order o INDEXED BY genre_order_title_desc
    CROSS JOIN tracks t ON t.id = o.id
    LEFT JOIN artwork w ON w.hash = t.artwork_hash
    WHERE o.genre_id = ?
    ORDER BY o.title_sort DESC, o.artist_sort ASC, o.path ASC, o.id ASC
    LIMIT ?
SELECT revision FROM genre_order_revisions WHERE genre_id = ?

SELECT o.id AS id, t.path IS NOT NULL AS hasFile,
      substr(o.title_sort, 1, 1) AS letter,
      o.title_sort AS k0, o.artist_sort AS k1, o.path AS k2, o.id AS k3
      
    FROM genre_order o INDEXED BY genre_order_title_desc
    CROSS JOIN tracks t ON t.id = o.id
    
    WHERE o.genre_id = ? AND o.title_sort = ? AND (o.artist_sort, o.path, o.id) > (?, ?, ?)
    ORDER BY o.title_sort DESC, o.artist_sort ASC, o.path ASC, o.id ASC
    LIMIT ?

SELECT o.id AS id, t.path IS NOT NULL AS hasFile,
      substr(o.artist_sort, 1, 1) AS letter,
      o.artist_sort AS k0, o.album_sort AS k1, o.album_id AS k2, o.disc_number AS k3, o.track_number AS k4, o.title_sort AS k5, o.path AS k6, o.id AS k7
      
    FROM genre_order o INDEXED BY genre_order_artist_asc
    CROSS JOIN tracks t ON t.id = o.id
    
    WHERE o.genre_id = ? AND (o.artist_sort, o.album_sort, o.album_id, o.disc_number, o.track_number, o.title_sort, o.path, o.id) > (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    ORDER BY o.artist_sort ASC, o.album_sort ASC, o.album_id ASC, o.disc_number ASC, o.track_number ASC, o.title_sort ASC, o.path ASC, o.id ASC
    LIMIT ?
plan: SEARCH o USING COVERING INDEX genre_order_artist_asc (genre_id=? AND (artist_sort,album_sort,album_id,disc_number,track_number,title_sort,path,id)>(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?))
SEARCH t USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

SELECT g.id AS id, g.name AS name, g.sort AS sort,
      (SELECT count(*) FROM tracks WHERE genre_id = g.id) AS trackCount,
      coalesce((SELECT revision FROM genre_order_revisions WHERE genre_id = g.id), 0) AS revision
    FROM genres g WHERE g.id = ?

SELECT o.id AS id, t.path IS NOT NULL AS hasFile,
      substr(o.artist_sort, 1, 1) AS letter,
      o.artist_sort AS k0, o.album_sort AS k1, o.album_id AS k2, o.disc_number AS k3, o.track_number AS k4, o.title_sort AS k5, o.path AS k6, o.id AS k7
      , t.title AS title, t.artist_credit AS artist, t.duration_ms AS durationMs,
            w.thumb_path AS thumbPath, t.path AS path, t.explicit AS explicit,
            t.album_id AS albumId, t.artist_id AS artistId, t.has_lyrics AS hasLyrics,
            (SELECT name FROM genres WHERE genres.id = t.genre_id) AS genre,
            t.track_number AS trackNumber, t.year AS year
    FROM genre_order o INDEXED BY genre_order_artist_desc
    CROSS JOIN tracks t ON t.id = o.id
    LEFT JOIN artwork w ON w.hash = t.artwork_hash
    WHERE o.genre_id = ?
    ORDER BY o.artist_sort DESC, o.album_sort ASC, o.album_id ASC, o.disc_number ASC, o.track_number ASC, o.title_sort ASC, o.path ASC, o.id ASC
    LIMIT ?

SELECT g.id AS id, g.name AS name, g.sort AS sort,
      (SELECT count(*) FROM tracks WHERE genre_id = g.id) AS trackCount,
      coalesce((SELECT revision FROM genre_order_revisions WHERE genre_id = g.id), 0) AS revision
    FROM genres g WHERE g.id = ?

SELECT o.id AS id, t.path IS NOT NULL AS hasFile,
      '' AS letter,
      o.added_at AS k0, o.title_sort AS k1, o.artist_sort AS k2, o.path AS k3, o.id AS k4
      , t.title AS title, t.artist_credit AS artist, t.duration_ms AS durationMs,
            w.thumb_path AS thumbPath, t.path AS path, t.explicit AS explicit,
            t.album_id AS albumId, t.artist_id AS artistId, t.has_lyrics AS hasLyrics,
            (SELECT name FROM genres WHERE genres.id = t.genre_id) AS genre,
            t.track_number AS trackNumber, t.year AS year
    FROM genre_order o INDEXED BY genre_order_added_asc
    CROSS JOIN tracks t ON t.id = o.id
    LEFT JOIN artwork w ON w.hash = t.artwork_hash
    WHERE o.genre_id = ?
    ORDER BY o.added_at ASC, o.title_sort ASC, o.artist_sort ASC, o.path ASC, o.id ASC
    LIMIT ?
SELECT revision FROM genre_order_revisions WHERE genre_id = ?

      o.added_at AS k0, o.title_sort AS k1, o.artist_sort AS k2, o.path AS k3, o.id AS k4
      
    FROM genre_order o INDEXED BY genre_order_added_asc
    CROSS JOIN tracks t ON t.id = o.id
    
    WHERE o.genre_id = ? AND (o.added_at, o.title_sort, o.artist_sort, o.path, o.id) > (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    ORDER BY o.added_at ASC, o.title_sort ASC, o.artist_sort ASC, o.path ASC, o.id ASC
    LIMIT ?

SELECT o.id AS id, t.path IS NOT NULL AS hasFile,
      '' AS letter,
      o.added_at AS k0, o.title_sort AS k1, o.artist_sort AS k2, o.path AS k3, o.id AS k4
      
    FROM genre_order o INDEXED BY genre_order_added_asc
    CROSS JOIN tracks t ON t.id = o.id
    
    WHERE o.genre_id = ? AND (o.added_at, o.title_sort, o.artist_sort, o.path, o.id) > (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    ORDER BY o.added_at ASC, o.title_sort ASC, o.artist_sort ASC, o.path ASC, o.id ASC
    LIMIT ?
plan: SEARCH o USING COVERING INDEX genre_order_added_asc (genre_id=? AND (added_at,title_sort,artist_sort,path,id)>(?,?,?,?,?))

      (SELECT count(*) FROM tracks WHERE genre_id = g.id) AS trackCount,
      coalesce((SELECT revision FROM genre_order_revisions WHERE genre_id = g.id), 0) AS revision
    FROM genres g WHERE g.id = ?

SELECT o.id AS id, t.path IS NOT NULL AS hasFile,
      substr(o.title_sort, 1, 1) AS letter,
      o.title_sort AS k0, o.artist_sort AS k1, o.path AS k2, o.id AS k3
      , t.title AS title, t.artist_credit AS artist, t.duration_ms AS durationMs,
            w.thumb_path AS thumbPath, t.path AS path, t.explicit AS explicit,
            t.album_id AS albumId, t.artist_id AS artistId, t.has_lyrics AS hasLyrics,
            (SELECT name FROM genres WHERE genres.id = t.genre_id) AS genre,
            t.track_number AS trackNumber, t.year AS year

    CROSS JOIN tracks t ON t.id = o.id

SELECT o.id AS id, t.path IS NOT NULL AS hasFile,
      substr(o.title_sort, 1, 1) AS letter,
      o.title_sort AS k0, o.artist_sort AS k1, o.path AS k2, o.id AS k3
      
    FROM genre_order o INDEXED BY genre_order_title_asc
    CROSS JOIN tracks t ON t.id = o.id
    
    WHERE o.genre_id = ? AND (o.title_sort, o.artist_sort, o.path, o.id) > (?, ?, ?, ?)
    ORDER BY o.title_sort ASC, o.artist_sort ASC, o.path ASC, o.id ASC
    LIMIT ?
plan: SEARCH o USING COVERING INDEX genre_order_title_asc (genre_id=? AND (title_sort,artist_sort,path,id)>(?,?,?,?))
